name: two_words_product_management
why: Spec: 'Two or more words → True' ("Product Management").

name: two_words_short_tokens_ai_tools
why: Spec: 'Two or more words → True' ("AI tools"), even though "AI" alone would be too short.

name: two_words_tab_separated
why: Spec: 'Split the phrase on whitespace' and 'Two or more words → True'; a tab separates two words.

name: two_words_newline_separated
why: Spec: 'Split the phrase on whitespace' and 'Two or more words → True'; newline separates two words.

name: uppercase_three_letters_crm
why: Spec: 'One word that is entirely upper-case ... True only if it has 3 or more characters' ("CRM" → True).

name: uppercase_three_letters_sql
why: Spec: 'One word that is entirely upper-case ... True only if it has 3 or more characters' ("SQL" → True).

name: uppercase_with_digit_sql2
why: Spec: entirely upper-case allows digits and requires 3+ characters; "SQL2" is upper-case with digit and length 4.

name: uppercase_two_letters_ai
why: Spec: 'One word that is entirely upper-case ... True only if it has 3 or more characters' ("AI", "ML" → False).

name: uppercase_two_chars_digit_s3
why: Spec: entirely upper-case allows digits; "S3" has fewer than 3 characters, so False.

name: uppercase_one_letter_a
why: Spec: 'One word that is entirely upper-case ... True only if it has 3 or more characters'; "A" has length 1.

name: uppercase_two_chars_digit_a1
why: Spec: "A1" is entirely upper-case with digits allowed and has fewer than 3 characters, so the upper-case rule makes it False despite containing a digit.

name: mixed_case_saas
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when a character after the first is upper-case' ("SaaS" → True).

name: mixed_case_pytorch
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when a character after the first is upper-case' ("PyTorch" → True).

name: mixed_case_ios
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when a character after the first is upper-case' ("iOS" → True).

name: digit_k8s
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when ... the word contains a digit' ("k8s" → True).

name: lower_first_upper_second_python
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when a character after the first is upper-case'; "pYthon" has upper-case Y after first.

name: two_char_mixed_case_ab
why: Spec: 'Any other single word → True when a character after the first is upper-case'; "aB" is not entirely upper-case and has upper-case B after first.

name: lowercase_product
why: Spec: otherwise False ("product" → False).

name: first_upper_only_engineering
why: Spec: otherwise False; "Engineering" has no upper-case character after the first and no digit.

name: first_upper_only_python
why: Spec: otherwise False; "Python" has no upper-case character after the first and no digit.
